raw: Maximum Purchase Quantity - Time Period (in Days)
Please input 0.10 to 1000000000.00 for product price. The price of the most expensive sku divided by the price of the cheapest sku limit: 7.00
If need to open cc installment, the price of item(at least one model) must bigger than 0
cc installment tenure, if cc installment off, This field will be ignored. Available tenure list is 3,6,12,18,24,36

MPQ is an item level field. Buyers can order different variations to achieve the min quantity. If left blank, MPQ will be 1 by default. Note that if stock is less than MPQ, buyers cannot place any order.
[Per Order + Per Time Period] It restricts the total quantity of an item each buyer can purchase per order or per time period. Please input from 1 to 999,999.
[Per Time Period only] Please select a MaxPQ start date. Earliest start date is tomorrow. Please enter the date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
[Per Time Period only] The Maximum Purchase Quantity limit will end (single time period) or restart (recurring time period) after the time period (in days). Please input from 1 to 365

[Per Time Period only] Please select a MaxPQ end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

For single period, end date should be start date + time period - 1. e.g. start date 2021-05-01, time period = 10 days. end date = 2021-05-10

For recurring time period, if you want MaxPQ to be repeated consecutively after each time period, the end date should be a multiple of the time period up to 29 times e.g. start date 2021-05-01, time period = 10 days, if you want the MaxPQ to repeat twice (total 3 periods), end date = 2021-05-30
